headline: Michael Carrick denies divisions within Man United squad after Lisandro Martínez outburst
description: Michael Carrick has insisted there are no divisions within the Manchester United dressing room after Lisandro Martínez criticised the strength of the squad.

headline: Arsenal's Mikel Arteta defends Viktor Gyökeres after goalless start to season
description: Mikel Arteta has defended Viktor Gyökeres amid criticism of the Arsenal striker's start to the season.

headline: Florian Wirtz form can improve if Liverpool drop him - Steven Gerrard
description: Liverpool legend Steven Gerrard has said that Florian Wirtz "coming out of the team" could be the solution to his confidence and form improving after a disappointing start to the season.
